evidence.reason: The code still stages the temporary config under `input.dir` while renaming it to `configPath`. Because `configPath` is computed with `path.resolve(input.dir, input.configPath ?? CQ_CONFIG_FILE)`, an absolute `configPath` can point to a different filesystem, and `renameSync` cannot move across filesystems (`EXDEV`), causing `--migrate` to fail. Staging under `dirname(configPath)` is the ordinary atomic-rename fix; the same applies to the stale-scratch sweep.
